Event.title: Event
Event.description: A marathon or race distribution event.

registrationStatus.description: Optional manual override or automatic schedule mode for event registration.

registrationOpensAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp when organizer scanning opens.

registrationClosesAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp when organizer scanning closes.

sheetsWebhookUrl.description: Optional Google Apps Script Web App URL for automatic Google Sheet sync.

sheetsWebhookSecret.description: Optional secret token verified by the Google Apps Script webhook.

sheetsAutoSync.description: Whether deliveries sync automatically to Google Sheets.

sheetsColumns.description: Bounded custom Google Sheets column mappings (max 40) defining each column header and data source.

deliverableItems.description: Bounded list of deliverable kit items (max 20), each optionally referencing dependsOnItemId for sequential chains.

displayFields.description: Bounded list of Excel column names displayed to organizers (max 20).

displayLabels.description: Optional custom Arabic labels for display fields.

nameField.description: Optional Excel/sheet column key explicitly chosen as the participant display name.

searchFields.description: Bounded list of fields used for smart fallback search (max 10).

Organizer.title: Organizer
Organizer.description: Race kit distribution booth organizer with assigned items and emergency kill-switch.

assignedItems.description: List of item IDs this organizer can distribute (max 20).

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: Registered marathon runner with normalized barcode, search keywords, dynamic Excel data, and per-item deliveries.

searchKeywords.description: Lowercase search prefixes and phone suffixes (max 60).

deliveries.description: Map of itemId to delivery record.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Immutable real-time audit log entry for deliveries and admin overrides.

DeliveryConflictResolution.title: DeliveryConflictResolution
DeliveryConflictResolution.description: Admin review record for an offline duplicate delivery conflict keyed by barcode__itemId.

/organizers/{organizerId}.description: Booth organizers keyed by organizer/magic token ID.

/events/{eventId}/participants/{barcode}.description: Participants sub-collection keyed by normalized barcode.

/events/{eventId}/activity_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable audit feed of deliveries and admin undo actions.

/events/{eventId}/delivery_conflicts/{co.description: Resolved status and review notes for duplicate offline delivery conflicts.
